Travel Information for PetCure Oncology Clifton, NJ Pet Cancer Care Patients & Visitors
Travel Information for PetCure Oncology Clifton, NJ Pet Cancer Care Patients & Visitors
PetCure Oncology Clifton, NJ
is proud to welcome pet families from around the country to the New York City area for pet oncology services. We understand how stressful traveling with a sick pet can be. And while each treatment plan is different, most pet families traveling from out-of-town will be away from home for three to four days while their dog or cat undergoes pet cancer treatment.
To that end, if you and your pet are planning a visit to PetCure Oncology Clifton for pet cancer treatment, we’d like to offer some helpful resources to make your visit and stay as stress-free as possible.
From nearby pet-friendly accommodations to
tips for keeping your cat or dog safe and comfortable while traveling
, we’ve got you covered. Plus, we’ll introduce you to some of the area’s favorite spots near the clinic where you can grab a bite to eat or take a break from your day. Let us help make your stay in the Clifton, New Jersey area as stress-free as possible! We hope that the following travel information will help you in your trip planning.
Areas We Serve
PetCure Oncology Clifton serves pet families from northern New Jersey, eastern Pennsylvania, New York City and Connecticut who are traveling to undergo pet cancer treatment. The following are just a few of the communities we serve along with distances and travel times to our PetCure Oncology Clifton facility.
If you’re visiting PetCure Oncology Clifton by car, it’s an easy drive from the following areas:
From the North, areas include:
Albany, NY – 138 miles / 2 hours 14-minute drive
Newburgh, NY – 61 miles / 1-hour14-minute drive

Public Transportation from New York City
If you’re traveling from the New York City/Manhattan area, PetCure Oncology Clifton is about a one-hour commute from Penn Station. From the New Jersey Transit train, you can expect to walk about 15-20 minutes between train and bus stops.
Public transit routes
can be easily accessed on Google.
Before traveling, consider your pet’s comfort and ability to walk as well as the ability to ascend stairs – such as those found on buses and trains. If you do not own a vehicle, you may also consider taking popular ride-share services such as
Uber
and
Lyft
. Plan ahead and ensure the vehicle you are taking allows animals.
Uber’s guidelines for riding with a pet
Lyft’s guidelines for riding with a pet
Airports Near Clifton, NJ
Traveling can be difficult enough without having to worry about your pet’s health. If you’re traveling with a pet cancer patient from out-of-state, the commercial airport closest to the Clifton, New Jersey area is Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) to the south. LaGuardia Airport (LGA) is slightly farther and to the east of Clifton. You’ll find that both Newark Liberty International and LaGuardia Airports are both modern facilities with dining areas, rest areas and animal relief areas where your cat or dog can stretch their legs and relieve themselves before or after a flight. Rest assured that your furry family member will be accommodated during travel.
International airports closest to Clifton, New Jersey:

Where to Stay & Eat Near Clifton, NJ
For pet families visiting from out of town, there are a number of lodging accommodations that are pet-friendly in the Clifton, New Jersey area. The area offers a variety of hotels that cater to dogs and cats, including those that offer special amenities such as dog parks and pet-friendly dining options. There are also a number of pet-friendly homes and apartments that can be found in the area using Airbnb or VRBO. We compiled the following list of accommodations in the area that are pet-friendly. As always, be sure to call ahead to ensure that each venue can accommodate your pet family and individual situation. We want you and your pet to find a comfortable and convenient place to stay while receiving treatment in the Clifton area. According to
BringFido.com
, the following hotels offer pet-friendly accommodations. Many of these hotels are minutes from PetCure Oncology Clifton.

Hotel Alternatives
VRBO Rentals
– VRBO has a pet filter so you can search for properties that allow pets on the premises. It’s still a good idea to contact the host to let them know about the type of pet you’re traveling with and why you’re traveling in the area.
Airbnb
– Note that Airbnb does not have a filter to find pet-friendly locations. You’ll have to look at individual listings to see the property’s pet policy. Also, Airbnb strongly encourages guests to contact the property owner before booking to ensure that they are comfortable with your situation.
Distances to/from PetCure Oncology Clifton will vary. You can easily map out the distance using
Google Maps
.
Starting Point: Enter the address of your lodging accommodations
Destination: Enter PetCure Oncology Clifton
Google Maps will calculate the distance and travel times
Pet-Friendly Restaurants Near Clifton, New Jersey
Clifton, New Jersey is home to many restaurants and coffee shops. In warmer months, when outdoor dining is available, many restaurants can accommodate dogs in outdoor seating areas. We know that traveling with a pet can be difficult, but you can find establishments that will allow your pet to accompany you outdoors.
Consider exploring these restaurants during your visit with us. According to New Jersey law, as of 2020, dogs and other pets are allowed in dining areas if specific conditions are met. You can read more about
Chloe’s Pet Access Law
for details. We suggest calling ahead to confirm specific policies regarding pets and how they may impact your intended plans.

Nearby Dog Parks
Note: Before visiting any dog park, check with your care team to determine which activities are suitable for your pet during treatment.
If you’re looking for some dog-friendly places to enjoy the outdoors while in the Clifton area, you’re in luck! The Clifton area has a number of dog parks where your furry friend can run, play, or just relax and get a breath of fresh air. The following dog parks are located minutes from PetCure Oncology Clifton. Weather permitting, stop by and enjoy the outdoors with your dog by your side – and don’t forget to bring a leash!
New Jersey Leash Laws – Dogs Must Be Leashed
The State of New Jersey does not have an overarching law regarding “dogs-at-large” but instead allows each municipality to determine its own standards. For the Clifton area,
section 203-10
of the law states:
“Running at large prohibited. No person shall suffer any licensed or unlicensed dog to run at large upon any of the streets or public places of the City or upon the property of any other person.”

We hope you’ve found this pet family travel guide for the Clifton, New Jersey area to be helpful in planning your trip to the area for pet oncology.
